name: product-taxonomy-bench
description:
Dataset Summary
	

product-taxonomy-bench is an anonymised benchmark dataset for predicting Shopify Product Taxonomy categories from Shopify product tags.
This dataset does not include raw product titles, raw tags, or product URLs. Tags are anonymised as tagNNNNNN.

evaluation_method: accuracy (top-1); macro-F1 often reported for imbalanced classes
reputation: Practical e-commerce-focused benchmark hosted on Hugging Face; used by practitioners for product taxonomy research but limited by anonymized tags.
